name: ctx-cache-band
description: Band above the prompt: context window used/max and prompt-cache TTL countdown + hit rate; optional auto-compact just before the cache expires.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache TTL (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: 5 or 60. Must match the TTL your account/session actually uses.

autoCompact.title: Auto-compact before cache expiry
autoCompact.description: Run /compact while the cache is still warm, so the idle-expiry re-cache is paid on a small context instead of the full one.

compactLeadMinutes.title: Compact when this many minutes of cache remain
compactLeadMinutes.description: Auto-compact fires once per idle window when remaining TTL drops to this.

minCompactTokens.title: Only auto-compact above this many context tokens
minCompactTokens.description: Below this, re-caching on return is cheap and compaction only loses detail.
